title: Khan Jahan Ali and Bagerhat-Khalifatabad
subtitle: A mosque-city in southern Bengal links frontier settlement, architecture, and Sultanate authority.
summary: Khan Jahan Ali is associated with the development of Khalifatabad, now Bagerhat, where a dense concentration of mosques, roads, tanks, and civic works emerged in the fifteenth century. The Historic Mosque City of Bagerhat is now recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage site.
heroTagline: A mosque-city in southern Bengal links frontier settlement, architecture, and Sultanate authority.
whyItMatters: Bagerhat shows how Sultanate-era authority, religious patronage, and settlement expansion reshaped southern Bengal outside the better-known capitals of Gaur, Pandua, and Sonargaon.
